title: T3 Chat & T3 Code Ecosystem vs Vox Best-of-All-Worlds Harness & Router Scorecard

dimensions.t3_ecosystem_best: vibheksoni/t3router (`ModelStatus` Operational/Degraded/Outage parsed from `/model-statuses`, surfaced as informational badges only)
dimensions.vox_pre_v3_9: Circuit-breaker penalty_map + failure_rate decay in `vox-orchestrator::models::select`, without pre-call provider health-status gating
dimensions.vox_post_v3_9: Full pre-call operational health gating (`ModelOperationalStatus::Operational | Degraded | Outage`) integrated into `decide()`, `select_local_first`, `select_via_premium_alias`, and `select_via_scorer`: `Outage` candidates excluded, `Degraded` candidates demoted when `Operational` alternatives exist

dimensions.t3_ecosystem_best: vibheksoni/pi-t3chat + TGlide/thom-chat (`reasoningEffort` low/medium/high and OpenRouter `:online` web-search suffix)
dimensions.vox_pre_v3_9: Static `Capability::SupportsReasoning` / `Capability::SupportsWebSearch` filtering without per-request reasoning effort budget or automatic `:online` suffix normalization
dimensions.vox_post_v3_9: Unified `ReasoningEffort` (`None | Low | Medium | High`) + `enable_web_search` on `ModelSelectionRequest::with_t3_controls` and `vox-llm-egress` (`T3WireOptions`, `normalize_egress_request_for_t3_options`, `build_request_with_t3_options` with automatic idempotent `:online` OpenRouter suffix and `reasoning_effort` wire serialization)

dimensions.t3_ecosystem_best: vibheksoni/t3router (`UsageTracker` pre/post-turn `queryUsage` delta with 3-tier token estimation fallback)
dimensions.vox_pre_v3_9: Pre-call `estimated_call_cost_usd` budget gate + post-call `BudgetSignal` EMA smoothing without explicit pre/post-turn delta receipt and provenance tiering
dimensions.vox_post_v3_9: `TurnCostDeltaReceipt` + `CostProvenanceTier` (`PlatformCredits | Byok | FreeTier | LocalZero`) + `ModelRegistry::reconcile_turn_cost_delta` feeding observed post-turn cost directly into `record_cost_observation`

dimensions.t3_ecosystem_best: TGlide/thom-chat (`resumable-stream` Redis pub/sub replay buffer) + helioschat/app (`StreamController` phase-aware reasoning/content/tool stream state + explicit abort)
dimensions.vox_pre_v3_9: Actor event streaming without sequence-numbered reconnect replay or phase-tagged abort preservation
dimensions.vox_post_v3_9: `ResumableTurnStreamRegistry` + `SequencedTurnChunk` + `TurnStreamEventKind` (`ReasoningDelta | TextDelta | ToolCallStart | ToolCallResult | Done | Error`) supporting `replay_after(thread_id, last_seq)` reconnect replay, `accumulated_snapshot`, and `cancel_turn` out-of-band cancellation

dimensions.vox_pre_v3_9: `ExternalMcpBridges` prefixed tool exposure (`ext.<server>.<tool>`) injecting every external schema upfront
dimensions.vox_post_v3_9: `LazyMcpGroupRegistry` on `vox-orchestrator-mcp::external_mcp` grouping `ext.<server>.<tool>` bridges into 3 lazy discovery primitives (`list_mcp_servers`, `list_mcp_tools`, `resolve_call_mcp`) with `MAX_LAZY_MCP_WRAPPER_ROUNDS = 6` while preserving full `ExternalMcpBridges` compatibility

dimensions.t3_ecosystem_best: TGlide/thom-chat (`/api/enhance-prompt` preserving `@<rule>` mentions) + helioschat/app (`Temporary Chat` zero-retention mode)
dimensions.vox_pre_v3_9: Spoke routing (`classify_conversation_spoke`) without `@<rule>` tag extraction or explicit zero-retention session posture contract
dimensions.vox_post_v3_9: `ModelRegistry::enhance_user_prompt_for_spoke` + `EnhancedPromptReceipt` (extracting and preserving `@<rule>` tags while attaching spoke directives) + `SessionPrivacyPosture` (`Standard | Ephemeral | LocalPrivate` gating DB persistence, memory extraction, and local-only model selection)

dimensions.t3_ecosystem_best: pingdotgg/t3code (`OrchestrationReactor` + git worktree isolation for 3 CLI harnesses: Codex, Claude, Cursor)
dimensions.vox_pre_v3_9: Native `vox-vcs` JJ/git worktree isolation + 7D multi-objective Pareto/Contextual Thompson Sampling router across OpenRouter, Ollama, Populi Mesh, and MENS models
dimensions.vox_post_v3_9: Combines Vox's 7D Pareto/Thompson router, Clavis secret isolation, and `vox-vcs` worktrees with T3's operational status gating, `:online` + `reasoningEffort` controls, post-turn cost reconciliation, resumable sequenced turn streams, and lazy MCP server grouping
